{{Quote|Depending on whose interpretation you believe, the Second Galactic Civil War was fought because the Galactic Alliance Defense Force wanted to take control of all military assets in the galaxy, or because the Corellian government was trying to reactivate the Centerpoint superweapon.|Thull Kabanard, ''Portraits in Late Galactic History''|<ref name="TEGtW" />}}
'''''Portraits in Late Galactic History''''' was an account of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] that was written by [[Thull Kabanard]] and published in [[81 ABY]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
